title: Daily lured-camera detections of 56 mammal and bird species at 50 boreal ponds, northern Quebec, 2018-2019 (latitude coarsened)
creator: Feldman, Mariano J.; Mazerolle, Marc J.; Imbeau, Louis; Fenton, Nicole J.
citation: Feldman, M. J., Mazerolle, M. J., Imbeau, L., & Fenton, N. J. (2023). Data from: Using camera traps to estimate habitat preferences and occupancy patterns of vertebrates in boreal wetlands [Dataset]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.jsxksn0g4
abstract: Lured camera arrays (three cameras per pond) at 50 beaver and peatland ponds in northern Quebec, two 7-day sessions in each of 2018 and 2019; daily detection of 11 mammal and 45 bird species, with rainfall, days since snowmelt, active cameras, pond type, distance to road, forest cover and latitude. The authors fitted a multispecies occupancy model.
samplingProtocol: Three infrared cameras per pond in a triangle at the pond edge with a scent lure, run 24 h for two sessions of seven consecutive days each summer; records of a species from any of the three cameras on a day are one daily detection.
closureNote: the authors treat each pond-year as a closed site over its 14 daily visits, although its two 7-day sessions are about seven weeks apart (obs_session; days since snowmelt jumps about 50 days between them); open between years
covariateNote: obs_session: 7-day session 1 or 2 within the year. obs_rain_cumulative: cumulative rainfall on the day (units not given). obs_days_since_snowmelt. obs_cameras_active: cameras of the three that were working that day. unit_pond_type: beaver or peatland pond. unit_dist_road_m: distance to the nearest road. unit_forest_cover_pct: forest cover within 1 km (NA for 3 ponds). unit_decimalLatitude: latitude only (no longitude deposited).
notes: Pond-year CASA_TO_8 2019 has no second session (no rows). Taxa are those recorded (11 mammals, 45 birds); vernacular names are the deposit's French names.
geographicCoverage: Northern Quebec, Canada, about 49.1-52.8 N (beaver and peatland ponds); latitude coarsened to 0.1 deg, no longitude deposited

coordinatesCoarsened.method: The Rusty Blackbird is IUCN VU in its native range (E7 b); the deposited latitude (0.01 deg; no longitude) is snapped to the centre of its 0.1 deg band. feldman_2023_quebec_wetland_exact_comm keeps the deposited latitude for the other 55 taxa.

notShipped.exact_latitude: latitude at the deposited 0.01 deg (coarsened, E7; exact in feldman_2023_quebec_wetland_exact_comm without the flagged taxon)
